title: Bounded below complexes embed quasi-isomorphically into complexes of injectives
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives, let $a\in\mathbf Z$ and let $K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $\mathcal A$ (indexed by $\mathbf Z$) with $K^n=0$ for $n<a$. Then there exist a cochain complex $I^\bullet$ of $\mathcal A$ whose terms $I^n$ are injective objects [def-sp-injective-resolutions], with $I^n=0$ for $n<a$, and a morphism of complexes $\alpha:K^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ such that every $\alpha^n:K^n\to I^n$ is a monomorphism and $\alpha$ is a quasi-isomorphism, i.e. $H^n(\alpha):H^n(K^\bullet)\to H^n(I^\bullet)$ is an isomorphism for every $n\in\mathbf Z$.
